scope: Architectural EL0 ID denial and read-only ID writes, precise guest/diagnostic privilege faults, Linux-only HWCAP_CPUID continuation and public C API frontiers

assumption_register.assumption: The regression profile represents ARMv8.2 without FEAT_IDST; its EL0 op1=000 ID accesses require the architectural Undefined path.
assumption_register.basis: Retained DDI 0487B.a D7.2.73 and AArch64.CheckSystemAccess; default ID_AA64MMFR2_EL1 is zero.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Direct typed error, full-system guest Undefined and diagnostic InvalidInstruction expectations.
assumption_register.stress_test: EL0 and EL1 reads; read-only writes; exact PC/GPR/private-state frontier; restored pre/post-delivery context.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: The tested profile advertises nonzero ID_AA64MMFR2_EL1.IDS, or an EL0 access mutates/retire state before reporting its fault.
assumption_register.verification: 13-case targeted library suite passed; FEAT_IDST and other optional profile classes remain outside this component.

assumption_register.assumption: Linux HWCAP_CPUID is personality-owned software continuation, with the retained Linux 6.19 user ID masks and safe defaults.
assumption_register.basis: Linux cpufeature.c, traps.c and sysreg.h; independent mask derivation matches all 31 tracked rows and 17 nonzero profiles.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Preserved Linux capability service with filtered identity/features and exact slice consumption.
assumption_register.stress_test: Zero/one/exact budget, prior retirement and u64 count wrap, reserved slots, XZR, unreadable code, PSTATE.IL, denied writes and unrelated privileged instructions.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: ID emulation bypasses a prior fault, leaks hidden identity, consumes no budget slot, or allows direct OS-neutral/full-system EL0 ID reads.
assumption_register.verification: Strategic and complete owning suites passed; primary mask derivation remains independently reproducible. Physical Linux kernel ID service was not executed.

assumption_register.assumption: The existing OS-neutral user adapter clears the local exclusive reservation on synchronous exits, including the ID fault used by Linux software emulation.
assumption_register.basis: A64UserCpu.run_observed clears the monitor for non-Yield exits; baseline LDXR/MRS/STXR violated the intended exception path because the core admitted MRS.
assumption_register.dependent_result: STXR cannot reuse a reservation established before the CPUID synchronous exit under the existing modeled policy.
assumption_register.stress_test: LDXR, emulated ID read and STXR in one exact user budget; existing same-thread budget-yield reservation tests remain owning-suite requirements.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: STXR succeeds with the pre-fault reservation after Linux ID emulation.
assumption_register.verification: Observed baseline failure in exclusive-red.json; corrected library regression passed. This is the adapter policy, not a claim that every Arm exception must clear every implementation monitor.

implementation.architecture: Remove the Linux ID whitelist from core EL0 access; reject guest MSR writes in op0=3/op1=0/CRn=0/CRm=0..7 before private storage mutation.
implementation.backend: Keep direct typed errors; deliver guest Undefined in system mode and InvalidInstruction in diagnostic mode.
implementation.Linux: After an actual Undefined exit, permission-check and reread the 4-byte word. Expose selected identity and masked feature registers with hidden safe defaults, XZR and BTYPE skip behavior. Consume exactly one user budget slot and preserve the existing synchronous-exit reservation policy.
implementation.state: No new CPU/OS policy or checkpoint field; public wire layouts and C ABI values/layouts unchanged.
implementation.complexity: O(S) work and temporary space for S exported system-register entries per emulated MRS; fixed-size decode/masks. Slice consumption is at least one slot and cannot overflow under retired < remaining <= u64::MAX.

validation.native_probe_limits: SIGILL disposition only for four physical Apple Silicon MRS reads; exact EC, AArch32 and Intel execution are unqualified.

validation.counts_note: Preflight and targeted cases also occur in complete owning suites. Counts are not unique-scenario totals. Ignored/self-skipped external oracle paths are not native validation.

coverage.direct: EL0/EL1 read and read-only-write frontiers; full captured private state equality
coverage.Linux: Exact/zero/wrapping budgets, identity filtering, hidden defaults, reserved slots, XZR, unreadable code, IL/fetch priority, unrelated signals, exclusive reservations
coverage.backend: System/diagnostic zero retirement and clock; guest vector/ELR/ESR; pre/post-exception private context round trips
coverage.native: Existing strict ID rejection and hot fallback frontier; no ID instruction is natively lowered
coverage.C_API: Precise typed fault or user exception, PC/GPR/count preservation; complete package and C/C++ consumers

bounded_scope.finding: FEAT_IDST and other optional profile/security/virtualization/debug exception classes are not qualified by the ARMv8.2 regression profile.
Restricted A32 rounding/NaN/subnormal controls and complete native backend/private/IRQ/scheduling/replay and physical Intel requirements remain open.
Existing EL0 HVC/HLT adapter retirement behavior remains a separate source-derived issue; the wrapper preserves its existing signal behavior.
Earlier unrelated Darwin ptrace/descriptor parallel failures remain unresolved; this group uses serial owning harnesses.

quality_gates.scope: Defined component acceptance only; no original full finding closure
quality_gates.provenance: Pinned primary hashes and independent derivation; direct observed baseline/green separation
quality_gates.integrity: Exact owned-path commit workflow and guarded cleanup; primary checkout and protected guests preserved
